ticket.summary: Active water pouring through dining room ceiling light fixture from suspected upstairs bathroom leak; customer closed house main (found in garage by water heater) and opened basement tap, flow slowing — on-call dispatched to 31 Halcyon Ct.
mitigation_advice: Shut off the house main by turning the valve clockwise; guided through basement, garage, crawl space and meter box locations until found next to the water heater in the garage [PB-02]
Open the lowest cold tap (basement sink) to drain remaining line pressure [PB-03]
Offered closing the upstairs fixture's supply shutoff (small oval handle, clockwise) [PB-01]
Stay out from under the wet, sagging ceiling and do not stand beneath it to empty the bucket [PB-08]
ticket.customer_message: Dispatching now — our on-call plumber will text you directly with an ETA, typically within the hour. Perfect on the porch light and side/garage access; I've noted it. Keep the main closed until they arrive, keep the basement tap open, and stay clear of the wet ceiling [PB-08]. You handled that shutoff like a pro.
